integrity_notes: Cartier matrix, semilinear iterate, finite elimination, discriminant test and supporting independent finite-field enumeration were verified using the embedded programs. No independent expert audit or priority certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: The 20 points are labelled parameter pairs over the algebraic closure, not geometric isomorphism classes. 7-rank zero does not imply supersingularity; Newton polygons and singular parameters are not classified.
title: Exact rank strata for a dihedral genus-four family in characteristic seven
